result.summary: The home screen is largely intact; the only notable visual issue is a layout overflow on the last restaurant card in the Fastest near you row.

issues.description: In the Fastest near you carousel, the third restaurant name is cut off as “Trattoria Piccol” instead of wrapping or truncating with an ellipsis, so the full title is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Constrain each card’s title to the card width and apply text overflow (ellipsis or 2-line wrap) so names stay fully readable.
